tasks.goal: a single-page habit tracker in one self-contained HTML file: a 7-day grid where each cell can be toggled done, a weekly completion percentage that updates live, and colour styling that changes as the percentage crosses 50% and 100%.
a single-page expense splitter in one self-contained HTML file: add named people and amounts they paid, then display who owes whom to settle up, recomputing live as entries change.
